notes.title: Big Demo Update and Tiny Teams
notes.notes:
We are very excited to say that we're participating in TinyTeams 2022, and that our demo will be available again from the 1st of August until an unspecified date (at least until the 8th).

If you have the demo in your Steam library already, you'll already see an update for the demo - the build will have "0.71" (or higher) on the top left corner. If you don't, you will be able to access the demo again on the 1st of August!

We would love to hear your thoughts on the changes and the new content, and if you run into any issues!

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
- New endscreen that shows your path taken in the demo
- A new dialogue path for the argument with Dunlin
- Shireen's Locket dream made more apparent
- WASD/Gamepad support!!
- A lot of voice lines have been cut up to be shorter so dialogue is quicker (more like movie subtitles)
- Resolutions now wont list every resolution under the sun, just the relevant ones
- Mindmap notifcation reworked, now hopefully more obvious
- Ability to dream on before waking up

[u][b]Things to note:[/b][/u]
- Due to changes made to the structure of saves, your saves from previous versions of the demo will not be compatible (the game will act like you have no saves, this is intended). 
- Your settings will also reset on first startup due to changes to settings, namely that you cannot rebind keys in the demo, and you cannot use both dyslexia font and font size at the same time.

Those of you on Linux, you might have to opt into a beta branch by inputting the following password: wherepenguinsgotosleep

notes.title: Demo Updates + Linux version
notes.notes:
A couple of small updates were pushed these past day. The update will show V0.42 (or higher) in the top left corner of the main menu.

- Lots of small art fixes
- Feedback form no longer shows the two unintended "Option Text" buttons that lead to a softlock
- The mindmap notification that pops up in the top right corner has been made yellow and a bit bigger for easier visibility
- Fixed a few buttons staying onscreen when they should have disappeared
- Fixed a few buttons displaying as unavailable when they should be interactable
- An issue was fixed where after the first line, the end screen was not interactive
- End screen should now properly display the buttons to leave the game after the demo ends

[b]Linux players, an experimental Linux build has been made available![/b] 
You should be able to download the demo now on the store page and opt into the Linux branch using "wherepenguinsgotosleep" as a password!

notes.title: Big Demo Fix Update
notes.notes:
The big fix update for the demo is now up! The update will show V0.32 (or higher) in the top left corner of the main menu.

[u][b]This update will fix the following issues in the demo:[/b][/u]
♢ Most importantly, fixed saving and loading saves
♢ Un-fried the feedback form[i]*[/i]
♢ "Snake's Tongue" achievement fixed
♢ End screen not fading out from black softlock fixed
♢ An alternate path in Dunlin convincing dialogue post first sleep is now available
♢ Adjusted how pausing works (you should be able to pause now normally unless a voiced line is playing)
♢ Mindmap can be exited using the pause button
♢ Mindmap can be exited anytime (even when an entry is displayed onscreen)
♢ Thought prompts updated to be more legible
♢ Fixed softlocks in the beach (shoes) and bonfire introspection sections
♢ Fixed white screen on endscreen and some other similar screens
♢ Thought prompts now clickable normally without having to use keyboard buttons
♢ Fixed some typos

*[i]Please send us feedback! We want to hear about your experience![/i]

Apologies for any issues caused earlier and we hope the update fixed any problems you've encountered before!

Also apologies to those not on a QWERTY keyboard about the non-rebindable up/down keys, we will allow these to be rebindable the next time the demo will be public!

notes.title: A Quick Update
notes.notes:
It's been a long time we posted an update, it was high time we posted a new one. We apologise for the radio silence.

We're working on a demo that we will make publicly available soon, and are preparing for a couple of events that will be featured on Steam. We will post about these as well as soon as we can, and details about the demo will soon follow once we know when it'll be available!

Development is going well, we have recently got some great voiceacting talent on board, had a few recording sessions. The performances are amazing, and we can't wait to show you more.

There is a character you have never seen, we are keeping our cards close to our chest, but just in case you thought it's going to be a bit of a sausage party...
